The river that runs through London is the River Thames.

The cohesion of the provided text is strong. It effectively uses transitional phrases and logical progression to link ideas. The first sentence introduces the main problem (coral reefs suffering). The second sentence adds a contributing factor using the phrase "also to blame," which connects smoothly to the first point. The third sentence shifts focus to the impact on fish populations, a direct consequence of the previous points. Finally, the fourth sentence broadens the scope to include human communities, using "This situation" as a cohesive device to refer back to the entire preceding context, thereby concluding the argument with a wider implication. The logical flow from cause to effect to broader impact is clear and well-connected.
